label: Выходить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for выходить (to go out, to exit).

missions.phrase: Я выхожу из дома в восемь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Выхожу' is the 1sg of выходить; the д of the stem mutates to ж in the first person. 'Из дома' shows the exit point in the genitive.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Выходишь' shows the -ишь ending with the д restored after the 1sg mutation. 'На следующей остановке' is a common transit phrase.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Выходит' is the -ит form of выходить, here marking a habit. 'Редко на улицу' frames the routine.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Выходим' carries the -им plural ending of выходить. 'На работу рано' describes a daily departure.
Strategic focus: Polite or plural present. 'Выходите' trains the -ите form of выходить. A short, very practical question for buses and elevators.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Выходят' closes the person ladder with the -ят ending of выходить. 'Гулять каждый вечер' marks a regular habit.
Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Выходил' is the masculine singular past of imperfective выходить with the -л suffix. The perfective partner is выйти.
Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Выходила' adds the feminine -ла ending of выходить. 'Из комнаты тихо' describes the manner of leaving.

missions.phrase: Мы будем выходить через главный вход.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective future. 'Будем' is the auxiliary and 'выходить' stays in the infinitive, forming the compound future. 'Через главный вход' names the route.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Выходи' is the informal command of выходить. 'Скорее' and 'мы опаздываем' make an urgent, natural call to one listener.
